_doc: Gunfire Modifiers (1997 Gunfire Results chart, p.110). crew_quality: 'select 1'. sections_firing keyed by sailor sections firing. rake / initial_broadside indexed by range-1 for ranges 1-5 (0 beyond range 5). two_targets applies to each target (chart: '-12 (ea.)'); one target with a half broadside (-8) is not carried here. plain_sail applies only at wind speed 2+ (chart footnote *). dismantling_shot ignores hull hits (chart footnote **). The chart's 'Dismasted: - Sea State' modifier is not a fixed number and is not carried here.
